'''
This is the main file for the IP address lookup CLI tool with a GUI.
It uses tkinter for the GUI and requests to interact with the ip-api.com API.
'''

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox
import requests

class IPInfoApp:
    '''
    A class to create a GUI application for IP address lookup.
    '''

    def __init__(self, root):
        '''
        Initialize the GUI components.
        '''
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("IP Address Lookup")

        self.label = tk.Label(root, text="Enter IP Address:")
        self.label.pack(pady=10)

        self.entry = tk.Entry(root, width=30)
        self.entry.pack(pady=5)

        self.lookup_button = tk.Button(root, text="Lookup", command=self.lookup_ip)
        self.lookup_button.pack(pady=10)

        self.result_text = tk.Text(root, height=10, width=50)
        self.result_text.pack(pady=10)

    def lookup_ip(self):
        '''
        Fetch IP information using the API and display it.
        '''
        ip_address = self.entry.get()
        if not ip_address:
            messagebox.showwarning("Input Error", "Please enter a valid IP address.")
            return

        try:
            data = fetch_ip_info(ip_address)
            self.display_result(data)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"An error occurred: {e}")

    def display_result(self, data):
        '''
        Display the fetched IP information in the text widget.
        '''
        self.result_text.delete(1.0, tk.END)
        if data['status'] == 'success':
            result = (
                f"IP: {data['query']}\n"
                f"Country: {data['country']}\n"
                f"Region: {data['regionName']}\n"
                f"City: {data['city']}\n"
                f"ISP: {data['isp']}\n"
                f"Latitude: {data['lat']}\n"
                f"Longitude: {data['lon']}\n"
            )
        else:
            result = "Error: Unable to fetch data. Please check the IP address."
        self.result_text.insert(tk.END, result)

def fetch_ip_info(ip_address):
    '''
    Make an API request to ip-api.com and return the response.
    '''
    url = f"http://ip-api.com/json/{ip_address}"
    response = requests.get(url)
    response.raise_for_status()  # Raise an error for bad responses
    return response.json()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = tk.Tk()
    app = IPInfoApp(root)
    root.mainloop()

import requests
import argparse
def fetch_ip_info(ip_address):
    '''
    Make an API request to ip-api.com and return the response.

            f"Latitude: {data['lat']}\n"
            f"Longitude: {data['lon']}\n"
        )
    else:
        result = "Error: Unable to fetch data. Please check the IP address."
    print(result)
def main():
    '''
    Parse command-line arguments and perform IP address lookup.
    '''
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='IP Address Lookup CLI Tool')
    parser.add_argument('ip_address', type=str, help='IP address to look up')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        data = fetch_ip_info(args.ip_address)
        display_result(data)
    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
